newsitem.title: USA: Full sentences urged for violent criminals.
newsitem.headline: Full sentences urged for violent criminals.

text.p: Criminals who commit violent crimes should be kept in prison for their full sentences, Sen. Byron Dorgan said Monday.

Dorgan, a North Dakota Democrat, said many violent criminals were being released early from state and federal prisons and then committing more crimes. He introduced a bill that would provide federal incentive payments to states that keep violent prisoners in jail for their full sentences.
"Once we apprehend, try and convict a violent criminal they ought to remain behind bars for the entire time to which they are sentenced," Dorgan said in a statement.

Several hundred prisoners are being released in Florida, including 200 on Monday, after the U.S. Supreme Court ruled last month the state could not revoke time credited to the inmates to deal with prison overcrowding.
The releases led one county sheriff in Florida to warn tourists to stay away from the state. State officials say the releases are not a threat to visitors or residents.
